 Shopping Shopee 11.11 Big Sale: Create the home of your dreams with these fab home and living deals
 By Honeycombers • 03 Nov 2026 
 Add as a preferred 
 source on Google 
 Copy link Share via Telegram Share via WhatsApp Share on Facebook Share on X (Twitter) Share on LinkedIn Share via Email Photography: Katemangostar via Magnific Calling all homeowners: the Shopee 11.11 Big Sale is upon us, and you know what this means… It’s time to cart out all your home necessities (including that new sofa you’ve been eyeing).
 About to kickstart your BTO reno and decor project? Or you just want to breathe some new life into your home? If these are part of your year-end plans, mark your calendars for the Shopee 11.11 Big Sale: we’ve got word there’ll be lots of great deals on Shopee Home across all home and living categories.
 Sofas, bed frames, computer chairs… You name it. So if there’s a cute coffee table you’ve been eyeing or sitting in your cart, take this as a sign to cart it out, stat. And if you’re just browsing, we’ve rounded up some of the fab deals we saw here.
 Shopee 11.11 2026 sale: Best home and living deals
 1. Lounge and chill: Cellini’s Hemma fabric convertible sofa bed
 Photography: Cellini 
 You need a guest bed, but you’re not always expecting guests. Something like Cellini’s Hemma fabric convertible sofa bed could fit the bill. With the size of a super single when opened flat to bed mode, this minimalist sofa bed fits nicely in your living or guest room. When there’s no guest, just set it to recline or sofa mode – there, all ready for some Netflix and chill time.
 2. Sleep well: Woosa’s pillow
 Photography: Woosa 
 When it comes to bedding and everything you need for a good night’s sleep, you can’t go wrong with Woosa. Woosa pillows come in four shapes and sizes, designed to complement your preferred sleep positions. There’s even a long pillow that couples can share comfortably – how about that?
 3. Statement piece with storage: Yeswood’s Vista oak wood coffee table with moru glass
 Photography: Yeswood 
 Nail that cosy Scandinavian home look with the Vista coffee table from Yeswood . Yeswood is a leading solid wood furniture brand from China, known for crafting beautiful home pieces from North American FAS grade oak wood that won’t break the bank. Functionality, aesthetics, and affordability – we stan this.
 4. Save on bedroom space: Megafurniture’s Devonne grey fabric storage bed
 Photography: Megafurniture 
 Need ample bedroom space? This storage bed might just be your wish come true. Megafurniture’s Devonne fabric storage bed comes with really generous storage space within the divan platform. Another plus point? Thanks to the powerful hydraulic system, you barely need to flex your muscles to lift the mattress and access your hidden stash.
 5. Walk on clouds: Cozylant’s Olivia rug
 Photography: Cozylant 
 Rugs can give your space a warm, inviting feel. Plus, a really good rug feels comfy and absorbs noise (your neighbours will thank you). For easy maintenance, look no further than Cozylant’s water-resistant Olivia rug . It’s easy to clean and maintain, durable, and feels oh-so-soft underfoot. Bliss!
 6. Solo lounging spot: Caler Home’s Axer fabric manual recliner armchair
 Photography: Caler Home 
 Always wanted an armchair that’s yours and yours alone? Treat yourself to the Axer recliner armchair from Caler Home , a perfect spot to put your feet up (for real), sit back, and relax. Trust us, it’s worth the splurge.
 Get ready to cart out this 11.11
 From practical finds to furniture that match your dream home’s aesthetics, you’re bound to find something that fits at Shopee Home . Featuring a wide range of trusted brands and products across all home and living categories, you can shop for all your home essentials right from your couch. What’s more, we heard there’ll be lots of fab deals coming up during the Shopee 11.11 Big Sale.
 So mark your calendars and set your alarm for 11.11, stat.
